10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:f49d5b41-2a5e-46.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced Notary or Candidate Notary looking to expand your impact in the realm of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Notary / Candidate Notary – AI Trainer and use your expertise to help shape the future of AI while enjoying flexible, remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects leading freelance experts with cutting-edge AI labs to accelerate progress in artificial intelligence. We are seeking EU or UK-based notaries and candidate notaries to help train and refine AI systems within the legal domain. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated content related to notarial acts, legal documentation, compliance, and regulatory matters - Assess the accuracy, completeness, and clarity of AI-generated notarial documents and suggestions - Create real-world scenarios and case studies drawing on your professional experience - Generate scenario variations that reflect best practices, legal standards, and risk considerations - Identify risks or inaccuracies in AI-generated content and provide structured, actionable feedback to enhance quality - Guide AI models in better understanding and applying key notarial and legal concepts About You: - Qualified Notary or Candidate Notary with practical experience in legal documentation and compliance - Based in the EU or UK - Strong skills in legal analysis, research, and documentation - Analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of giving clear, constructive feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week and comfortable working asynchronously/remotely Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance roles – 100% remote - Directly impact how AI supports and understands notarial workflows and legal compliance - Access professional development through the 10x Team AI Academy - Become part of a dynamic expert community with streamlined onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the future of AI-powered legal solutions—apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

ace1media-ace-1-media:ashbyhq:06853d7a-d.title: Growth Manager
ace1media-ace-1-media:ashbyhq:06853d7a-d.description: ABOUT US Ace 1 Media is a fast-growing, technology-driven performance marketing company specializing in AI-powered media automation and scalable monetization strategies. We focus on data, performance, and measurable growth. We are looking for a results-driven Growth Manager to lead and scale our paid media efforts. ROLE OVERVIEW The Growth Manager will be responsible for driving user acquisition, managing paid media campaigns, and optimizing performance across multiple traffic channels. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone with strong media buying experience and a passion for scaling profitable campaigns. Search arbitrage experience is a strong asset. This role is remote-friendly but candidates must be based in Vancouver, BC. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Native, etc.) - Manage and scale advertising budgets with a strong focus on ROI and ROAS - Develop and execute growth strategies to increase revenue and acquisition - Monitor and optimize key metrics: CPA, CAC, ROAS, LTV - Conduct A/B testing on creatives, landing pages, and targeting - Analyze campaign data and generate performance insights - Identify and test new traffic sources and scaling opportunities Search Arbitrage (Plus): - Execute and scale search arbitrage campaigns - Optimize keyword bidding strategies and monetization funnels - Monitor CPC trends and traffic quality REQUIREMENTS - Minimum 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or media buying - Proven experience managing paid ad campaigns and budgets - Strong analytical and data-driven mindset - Experience with Google Ads and at least one other paid platform - Familiarity with tracking and analytics tools (GA4, Voluum, RedTrack, etc.) - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment NICE TO HAVE - Search arbitrage experience - Affiliate marketing background - Experience in AdTech or performance-driven environments - CRO and landing page optimization experience COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - Competitive salary (based on experience) - Performance-based bonus opportunities - Remote flexibility (Vancouver-based candidates only) - Opportunity to grow within a scaling media company - Pay: CA$60,000.00 - CA$120,000.00 per year

aestudio-aestudio:greenhouse:6009528004.description: AE Studio is a 160-person ML consultancy dedicated to solving the hardest problems in AI. We use our profits to fund research on the most important problems in AI Safety and Alignment. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. Our research is published in top ML conferences and currently deployed in safety-critical systems. AE Studio was founded 10 years ago with the goal of helping corporate clients develop humanity-affirming, agency-promoting technology. Since then we’ve developed a reputation for rapidly delivering world-class solutions to their hardest problems. We take the same client-centric approach to research, partnering with the world’s best external researchers to develop world-class results. They provide the vision and our researchers make their ideas a reality. Our core alignment team is 25 researchers and growing. We hire from all backgrounds. Whether you’re an independent researcher, an engineer, or an academic, AE is a place to make real impact on the single most important problem of our time. We research a diverse set of ambitious alignment directions that others neglect, including pretraining interventions for model safety, novel interpretability techniques, neuroscience-inspired approaches to alignment, and many others. You can learn more about our team and work from our Alignment Podcast as well as our research page . About the role Our ideal candidate is a high-agency technical generalist. Our researchers spend ~100% of their time on alignment R&D, working autonomously in fast-paced, high-stakes environments and guiding research direction alongside our collaborators. About you Experienced in ML research, alignment research, or both Deeply passionate about AI alignment & believe genuine progress is possible Excellent at Python, Pytorch, and the modern deep learning stack Knowledgeable about building, training, or evaluating deep learning models Comfortable calling AI model APIs via REST or client libraries Adept at decomposing complex problems into concrete, testable experiments AI-native, and eager to use AI tools to automate your workflow Thrives in a fast-paced, startup-like environment Adept in English and comfortable communicating technical work to all audiences Bonus Experience performing self-directed research or data science projects (show us what you've built, especially if it increases human agency) Software engineering background and best practices Agile experience (Kanban, Scrum, XP) Experience managing clients and client relationships Experience in startups Being in LA to work from our office Benefits Remote-first with flexible schedules. Coworking spaces available in the Bay Area and NYC. Platinum health insurance, free lunches at the office, weekly knowledge-sharing talks, and an annual team retreat. Regular performance-based raises and a diversified employee equity program. Compensation Salary range is $180K to $240K per year for US-based candidates. Not in the range? Apply anyway. We're growing fast and may have other roles opening soon.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:61db58b8-cfb7-.title: Mid Level AI Engineer PL - Java
jobgether-jobgether:lever:61db58b8-cfb7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mid Level AI Engineer PL - Java based in Brazil. As an AI Engineer, you will help transform artificial intelligence capabilities into practical, business-focused solutions with real-world impact. You will contribute to building a new Java-based engine using Spring to support AI-powered documentation through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The role combines backend engineering with emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, agents, prompt engineering, and retrieval systems. You will design multi-step automations and AI interactions while ensuring quality, security, and reliability in production environments. Working end-to-end, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and adapt to different technology stacks and project requirements. You will have the opportunity to work with modern AI development practices and contribute to innovative, AI-native engineering approaches. This is a strong opportunity for a proactive engineer who enjoys learning, experimenting, and turning new AI capabilities into scalable software. AI-Powered Backend Development: Design and develop a robust Java/Spring engine supporting AI-powered documentation generation and other intelligent application capabilities. AI Agent Development: Implement automations and interactions with technical environments using AI agents capable of executing multi-step tasks. RAG Solutions: Build and integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation capabilities to provide relevant, contextual information to AI-powered applications. AI Specifications: Structure clear specifications and context for AI models while maintaining appropriate quality, security, and production controls. End-to-End AI Engineering: Contribute across the complete AI development lifecycle, from solution design and implementation through integration, testing, and production deployment. Prompt & Model Integration: Develop effective prompts and integrate appropriate AI models, skills, and supporting technologies into software solutions. AI Architecture: Apply concepts such as Harness Engineering, MCP, token management, AI context, and Software Design Documents to create reliable AI-enabled applications. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and project teams to integrate AI capabilities effectively into existing and new technology solutions. Technology Adaptability: Navigate different technology stacks and development environments, adapting technical approaches to the specific needs of each project. Innovation: Explore emerging AI technologies, methodologies, and approaches to continuously improve solution quality and engineering efficiency. Requirements: Professional Experience: Mid-level experience in software engineering or AI engineering, with a strong foundation in backend development. Java Development: Solid experience developing applications with Java; knowledge of the Spring framework is strongly preferred. AI & LLMs: Practical understanding of Large Language Models and how they can be incorporated into production software applications. RAG: Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation concepts and experience applying retrieval-based approaches to AI solutions. Prompt Engineering: Ability to design and refine effective prompts for interacting with AI models and achieving reliable outputs. AI Agents & Skills: Understanding of AI agents, multi-step task execution, and the development or implementation of AI skills. Modern AI Concepts: Familiarity with MCP, token management, AI context, Harness Engineering, AIDLC, and SDD practices. AI Models: Understanding of different AI models and the ability to select and apply them according to project requirements. Technical Adaptability: Ability to work comfortably across different technologies and technology stacks as project needs evolve. Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities,
